question: can centre/scale be rebuilt from the frozen inputs + deterministic code?
answered: YES - rebuilt for all 3 repeats x 9 folds; l1_change_z/mean_abs_change_z reproduce
method: centre/scale = L.fit_standardizer(apply_median(X[context_idx])) where context_idx = training rows of (repeat,fold) with source style removed, exactly as the production fold loop builds it; z = (x - centre)/scale; l1 = sum|z_new - z_source|.

tolerance.note: float64 replay of the same arithmetic

scope_note: The fit function itself is the frozen production code: this proves the declared z-space movement is reproducible from the frozen inputs, it does NOT prove the objective/constraint model behind the QP.
